subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Orchard Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Orchard Health

Hi Janelle —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as we kick off the security review: 

What we covered
- Primary goals: confirm systems in scope, identify security/legal/procurement stakeholders, and agree on timeline to complete the questionnaire and evidence handoff.
- High-level decision criteria you called out: data residency, HIPAA controls (audit logs, encryption at rest/in transit), and predictable latency for inference.

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed)
- Economic / procurement owner: Carlos Rivera (procurement).
- Security reviewer / day-to-day contact: Janelle Ortiz (security).
- Legal: TBD (you mentioned Melissa Cruz from legal might join for contract redlines).
- Engineering / integration: Carlos's infra lead (you said you would share name).

Systems in scope (initial ask)
- EHR integration (FHIR endpoints)
- Patient portal (Auth + API)
- Analytics/data warehouse where inference outputs are stored

Next steps
1) I attached our security intake questionnaire (security_questionnaire_v1.pdf) and a simple systems-scope spreadsheet (orchard_systems_scope.xlsx). Can you please confirm the list of systems and provide the contact for procurement/legal by EOD Monday (June 14)?
2) If possible, have your security team fill the questionnaire or nominate a point-person we can pair with — target to complete initial intake by June 18.
3) Rishi will follow up with specific questions about network topology and data flows.

Attachments: security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF), orchard_systems_scope.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--

From: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@orchardhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Orchard Health

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few updates / confirmations: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: Carlos (procurement) and I (security) will own this. Legal contact is Melissa Cruz (melissa.cruz@orchardhealth.com) — I'll loop her in once we have a baseline questionnaire.
- Systems in scope: EHR (FHIR), patient portal, analytics warehouse (Snowflake), and a preview environment running in our AWS account where inference will be tested.
- Decision timeline: we are targeting a vendor security sign-off + procurement approval by July 2 to align with the pilot start.

I've started filling the questionnaire — attaching a partially completed intake (orchard_questionnaire_partial.pdf) and our internal systems list (orchard_systems_scope_filled.xlsx). Rishi, please let me know if you need detailed network diagrams or sample logs.

Thanks — Janelle

Attachments: orchard_questionnaire_partial.pdf (PDF), orchard_systems_scope_filled.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Ortiz <janelle@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Melissa Cruz <melissa.cruz@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Orchard Health

Appreciate the quick turn, Janelle — this is perfect. Two small asks from our side: 

1) Could you share the preview AWS account ID or a read-only role we can use to validate network egress rules? If not possible, a high-level network diagram and S3 bucket names for inference artifacts will work.
2) For procurement/timeline: Carlos, can we schedule a 30-min sync next week (Jun 15–17) to align on pricing/contract path & required PO process?

Rishi/Evelyn — I'll leave it to you two to follow up on the technical intake items. I also attached a simple network diagram we typically request (network_diagram_s3_storage.png) to illustrate the exact fields we need.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Ortiz <janelle@orchardhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Orchard Health

Hi Janelle — quick technical checklist based on the partial intake you sent: 

- For EHR (FHIR) endpoints: can you confirm whether the FHIR traffic will be routed through a private VPC endpoint or over the public internet with mTLS? We need to know for cert / peer-auth planning.
- Analytics warehouse: does Orchard allow external read-only service accounts to pull a subset of non-PHI records for model evaluation? If not, we can propose an alternate approach (on-premise evaluation).
- Preview AWS: if you can provide an IAM role ARN with read-only S3 and restricted EC2 describe rights, that would speed up validation. Otherwise, the diagram you attached is sufficient to start.

I'll consolidate technical asks into a single doc and send by end of day.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@orchardhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Orchard Health

Thanks everyone — quick replies inline: 

- FHIR traffic will be through a private VPC endpoint (we'll provide the VPC ID and peering details).
- Snowflake: we can create a read-only role scoped to a non-PHI schema for evaluation. I'll coordinate with analytics to provision.
- AWS preview account: I'll request a cross-account read-only role and share the ARN by Monday.
- Carlos: I'm copying you to confirm availability for a procurement sync next week (prefer Jun 16 or 17).

I'll aim to have the questionnaire fully completed by Tues (June 15) and send the network diagrams/ARNs then.

Best,
Janelle Ortiz
Senior InfoSec Manager | Orchard Health
